designationHistory.name: Johnson Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Johnson Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8122, reserving about 1,928 acres in Eddy and Nelson Counties, North Dakota.
designationHistory.note: The 2006 FWS North Dakota Limited-interest Refuges CCP (Table 4) lists Johnson Lake as EO 8120; that is a misprint. The order text in the FWS file and the Presidency Project both carry No. 8122 (EO 8120 established Half-Way Lake). Renamed by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.
